newsitem.title: UKRAINE: FORECAST-Ukraine Nov,Dec inflation 1.5 pct or less.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Ukraine Nov,Dec inflation 1.5 pct or less.

text.p: Ukraine's monthly inflation rate in November and December should be no higher than last month's 1.5 percent, Deputy Prime Minister Viktor Pynzenyk said at the weekend.
"Despite the seasonal rise in consumer prices at the end of the year I expect monthly inflation in November and December close to one percent," Pynzenyk told a news conference.
The Statistics Ministry has not yet released inflation data for November.
Ukraine's monthly inflation rate slowed to 1.5 percent in October from 2.0 percent in September.
The minister added the government has maintained its annual forecast at 40 percent, down from last year's 182 percent.
According to the Statistics Ministry, annual inflation for the first 10 months of the year stood at 36.8 percent.
Ukraine's 1997 draft budget foresees annual inflation of 25 percent for the next year.
